changes.problem: COTP CR destination reference was a mutable Head value although no remote transport reference exists yet.
changes.resolution: Fix CR destination_reference to zero; retain CC correlation to the actual CR source_reference.

changes.problem: Association context/version descriptors allowed values rejected by the current codec; other message context IDs were visible only in static trees.
changes.resolution: Fix association presentation context and MMS version to1, and declare explicit fixed context3 for MMS services/conclude or context1 for ACSE release.

changes.problem: Read/Write structure trees advertised multiple variables and variable-list-name while the codec supports one domain-specific name.
changes.resolution: Restrict variable access to exactly one domain/item pair and require both identifiers to be nonempty.

changes.problem: Write listed arbitrary MMS Data and arrays, but the codec only replaces one VisibleString data leaf.
changes.resolution: Restrict list_of_data to one context10 VisibleString; explicitly enumerate the bounded Read-result Data alternatives accepted by this codec.

changes.problem: State guards/actions suggested general negotiated outstanding-transaction handling.
changes.resolution: Make single-flight scheduling and non-executable guards/actions explicit without claiming a multi-transaction scheduler.

changes.problem: Container content fields could be mistaken for general BER/session encoders.
changes.resolution: Keep complete container projections but mark their static-tree status and require named codec leaves for mutation.

codec_constraints.constraint: Complete TPKT/COTP TP0 CR/CC with C0 TPDU-size and C1/C2 TSAP parameters; LI equals record bytes minus5. CR destination reference is fixed0; CC destination correlates to CR source reference.

Session CONNECT/ACCEPT, normal-mode presentation context1, ACSE AARQ/accepted AARE with application context1.0.9506.2.3 and embedded MMS Initiate; fixed MMS version1. Initiate is not a standalone TCP message.
Presentation context3, ConfirmedRequest GetNameList for basic object class domain9 and VMD-specific scope; one current invoke.
Presentation context3, current invoke correlation, Identifier result sequence and one-octet moreFollows boolean0/255.
Exactly one domain-specific named variable; nonempty domain/item VisibleStrings. No variable-list-name, alternate access or variable array. Write carries one context10 VisibleString value.

Presentation context3 with current invoke correlation. Codec result tags are failure0, boolean3, integer5, unsigned6, float7, octets9, VisibleString10 or UtcTime17; the tree does not certify complete normative semantics of every encoded Data value.
Presentation context3, current invoke correlation, response result choices restricted to DataAccessError context0 or zero-length success NULL context1.
Presentation context3 with empty MMS conclude request tag11 / response tag12; conclude does not by itself release the ACSE/session association.
Session FINISH/DISCONNECT, presentation context1 and ACSE RLRQ normal reason0 / empty RLRE; requires the model conclude handshake first.

State edges are modeled, but guards/actions and structure_model are static annotations. The host independently allows one pending request. General negotiated outstanding limits and whole opaque container mutation are not implemented.

remaining_gaps.description: The profile does not implement complete IEC61850 ACSI/ISO9506 services, reports, data sets, GOOSE/SV, generalized arrays/alternate access, arbitrary authentication, TLS or all failure branches.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Add service-specific field/state models, reference fixtures and encoder/parser support from the required standard version before extending the claim.

remaining_gaps.description: Guard/action strings do not enforce negotiated outstanding limits. General session/presentation/BER container replacement and arbitrary MMS Data generation are absent.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Implement explicit execution support and independent contracts if required; retain single-flight and supported leaf replacements meanwhile.

remaining_gaps.description: generic_wire.json contains only COTP CR/CC, is online:false and omits twelve association/service/conclude/release messages. Flat uint/bytes cannot represent required recursive BER, session/presentation and ACSE semantics.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Extend the generic grammar/loader with bounded recursive structures, semantic wrappers and response rules, then construct all service descriptions. Fixed opaque fixtures and online=true are not substitutes.

remaining_gaps.description: This independent reviewed YAML candidate has only static schema/data review; no native validator, tests or target session were run for it.
remaining_gaps.resolution: Generate native-validated IR and a fresh model corpus into a new package, then verify actual session, correlations, boundaries and method comparisons separately.
